author: val
body: The values are sine times 1000 at 0, 6, 12 ... 90 degrees. They are a table rather than a series because a series here would be a slower way to get the same sixteen numbers, and the numbers are what a reader wants to check.

author: val
body: Sixty positions cover twelve hours at five per hour, so the hour position is `h mod 12` times five plus the minutes divided by twelve.
